title: Lighting Crew Visit Table — Area and Security Lighting Rental on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule Restore
content:
**Visit table.** Where an Area and Security Lighting Rental light is rented on an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account that is being restored, the restore crew attends to the light and the restore adds a charge to the restore fee. The rental's status and additional pole count are read from the lighting rental record of the same service account.

| Area light rented on the account | Crew work | Added to the restore fee |
|---|---|---|
| Out of service | The restore crew relamps it | $15.00 |
| Active, standing on one or more additional poles | Pole visit | $7.50 |
| Active with no additional pole, any other status, or no light rented | — | Nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

| Lighting rental record | Added |
|---|---|
| LED 110W Flood Light, out of service | $15.00 |
| LED 70W Area Light, active, 1 additional pole | $7.50 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light, removal pending | Nothing |
